messages:
amelia: heads up — customer's SCIM deprovisioning stopped after last night's RBAC prune. Getting 403 from idp-proxy with a decryption error. unsure if KMS rekey or role change is root cause.

```
2026-03-21T03:12:04Z ERROR scim/provisioner deprovision failed status=403 body=\"encrypted_extid: decryption_failed\" req_id=abc123 svc=provisioner
2026-03-21T03:12:04Z WARN  scim/provisioner role_lookup status=404 body=\"role_not_found: product-admin:scim-service\" req_id=abc123
```

carlos: seen. is that 403 on decrypt or a downstream 403 from the idp? can you paste the req_id again?

amelia: req_id=abc123. the stack shows decrypt fails first, then we fall back to role lookup and that returns role_not_found. looks like both errors present.

devops-bot: KMS rotation complete for alias `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/prod-scim-kms` at 2026-03-21T01:00:02Z (rotation-id: rot-20260321-01).

vijay: if the ciphertext header contains an old key id, and the provisioner caches key blobs, a rotation can make the cache stale. we try envelope decrypt with header.kid. can you check if ciphertext kid != current alias?

maria: also recall we ran an RBAC tidy last night and removed the `scim-service` principal from `product-admin` for least-privilege. that would explain role_not_found on lookup.

amelia: tracing the request: deprov request arrives -> idp-proxy attempts to decrypt extid -> decrypt fails (so mapping can't proceed) -> fallback logs role lookup but decryption is the blocking error. so KMS seems primary, RBAC change is secondary for some flows.

carlos: try a direct debug call to idp-proxy decrypt endpoint so we can see key header. run: 

```
curl -s -H 'X-Request-ID: debug-001' "https://idp-proxy.internal/_debug/decrypt?ct=abc123" -o /tmp/decrypt.out -w '%{http_code}\\n'
```

amelia: ran that, got 500 + payload: \"key not found in cache: alias/prod-scim-kms\" then stack: `kms.client.EnvelopeDecryptError: no matching keyring for kid 'arn:aws:kms:...:cmk-OLD'`

vijay: ok that matches cached-key mismatch. short-term fix: restart provisioner pods to force key reloads and clear in-memory key cache. long-term: we should subscribe to KMS rotation events and invalidate caches.

maria: and for RBAC impact: we should rollback the prune that removed `scim-service` from `product-admin` so deprovs relying on that lookup succeed while we debug. i've opened a ticket to track the rollback and audit backfill. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-9876

amelia: restarting provisioner now (rolling restart). will monitor deprov queue.

devops-bot: Deployment restart initiated by amelia on service `provisioner-service` (env=prod). restart_id=rs-20260321-1713 ETA ~45s.

amelia: restart complete. re-ran the debug decrypt curl -> 200 OK and decrypted payload shows kid=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:cmk-NEW. deprovision queue started processing and flushed 12 pending deprovs for the customer.

amelia: immediate mitigation done. follow-ups: 1) implement KMS-rotation -> webhook to provisioner to clear key cache; 2) add CI acceptance test for rotation; 3) backfill audit events for the 01:00-02:00 window; 4) review RBAC prune process for safety net.

carlos: agree. suggest adding a post-rotate hook in the rotation automation that calls `POST /internal/keys/invalidate` on all services. i'll draft a small PR.

vijay: i'll subscribe provisioner to rotation SNS and open PR to auto-clear cache and emit metrics on cache-misses after rotation. also adding a unit test for envelope decrypt header mismatch.

maria: SEC-9876 created, assigned to @vijay and @carlos for code changes. tagging security and infra for PM updates.

amelia: quick triage decision: impact limited to one customer, ~1hr downtime for deprovs. propose sev3.

maria: :thumbsup: sev3 ok.

carlos: agreed sev3. will include remediation timeline in the ticket.

amelia: thanks all — will put a short blameless postmortem in Friday all-hands notes and link SEC-9876.
